messages:
Ivy: Quick sync  finalizing the newsletter + launch email for the Benchmark webinar. Need: subject A/B, a separate onboarding-nurture path for recent signups, suppression rules, and preview counts. Can we lock by EOD?

Noah: Subject ideas: A) "Benchmark webinar: cut inference cost, keep latency" B) "Real benchmark results + engineering playbook". Preheader: "Live demos, customer data, and Q&A". Lean B for dev lists.

Gia: For onboarding-nurture, propose a short 3-email drip: Day 0 invite, Day 3 reminder with highlights, Day 7 follow-up with on-demand link. Only send invite to trials created <7d and opens>0. Keep lapsed trials separate.

Ravi: Suppression rules: exclude suppression_marketing_master, last_7d sends, and bounced domains. Quick SQL snippet for trial invite segment:
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE trial_start > now()-7
AND email_opens_last_14 > 0
AND unsubscribed = false
AND email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM suppression_marketing_master)
```
Add domain-level bounce check too.

ops-bot: Campaign preflight queued: benchmark-webinar-newsletter-2026. Raw recipients pre-suppression: 10,980. Dedupe & suppression ETA 1h. Default throttles suggested: 5k/hr initial, 3k/hr subsequent.

Ivy: Good. @Gia please draft the Day 0 copy with two short sections: "What's new" (3 bullets) and "Why it matters" (1 sentence) for the public newsletter. Keep body <180 words.

Gia: Will do. Also suggest we A/B CTA microcopy for the marketing list: Variant A = "See the benchmark" Variant B = "Watch the demo". Keep subject constant to isolate CTR.

Noah: Agree. For segmentation: marketing list = broad (opens>1 last 30d), nurture = trials<7d, lapsed = last_login 30-90d with opens<2. Ops: can you provide preview counts once suppression runs?

ops-bot: Post-suppression preview counts: marketing list = 7,920; trials invite = 2,110; lapsed followup = 850. Unique emails total = 10,880 (100 dups removed). Recommend 3 timezone passes: US/EMEA/APAC. Throttle recs: 5k/hr, 3k/hr, 2k/hr.

Ivy: Perfect. Final asks: cap subjects to 60 chars, preheaders 100. @Ravi please add utm_campaign=benchmark_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter and map utm_content per CTA. I'll post final send approval after Gia uploads the draft copy and ops posts final send report. Thanks! :rocket:
